description: This file defines the 'Stories' class within the Goteo project, managing story data including retrieval, listing, validation, saving, and ordering of stories, along with related data such as project and user information.

classes.name: Stories
classes.description: A model class representing stories (likely success stories or case studies) within the Goteo project, handling data access, manipulation, and validation related to stories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Stories instance, setting default values using configuration if necessary.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns fields related to language-specific content for stories.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific story by its ID, including related project and user data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all stories with optional filtering by active status, pool, and other criteria, including pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a list of stories based on filters, supporting pagination and count.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns projects available to feature as stories, excluding the current project.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the story instance, primarily checking for a missing title.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the project associated with this story.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the user associated with this story or its project.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the image object associated with this story.

methods.name: getSphere
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the sphere object associated with this story.

methods.name: getPoolImage
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the pool image associated with this story.

methods.name: getBackgroundImage
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the background image for the story.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the story, handling associated image uploads and database persistence.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of a story by its ID.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders a story upward in its list based on 'order'.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders a story downward in its list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for a new story within a node.

methods.name: getListTypes
methods.description: Returns available story types from configuration.
